title: Service Agreement - Gartner, Inc. - Technology Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Service Agreement by and between  District and Gartner, Inc., Stamford, CT, for the latter to provide its Gartner for IT Leaders Service, as described in Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, to the Technology Services Department, for the term July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, in an  amount not to exceed $44,310.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $44,310 for Gartner's "Gartner for IT Leaders" service for the Technology Services Department
summary: The Board is formally ratifying (confirming) an agreement with Gartner, Inc. of Stamford, CT, for its "Gartner for IT Leaders" service, which is provided to the Technology Services Department. Spending is capped at $44,310 for July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, paid from general-purpose funds. The agreement's term began before the Board's August 24, 2022 vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 2, Hosted Software License Agreement - Be A Mentor - Technology Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 2, Hosted Software License Agreement, including Schedule A (School Year 2022-2023) by and between District and Be a Mentor, Inc., Hayward, CA, for the latter to host the Vendor Management System (VMS), the application for vendor processing, conducting background screening and clearances and tracking ongoing arrest records of same for up to 120 District vendors, as described in the Amended Agreement, extending the term of the Agreement from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2022 to June 30, 2023, in the additional amount of $9,900.00, increasing the not to exceed amount of the Agreement from $19,800.00 to $29,700.00, via the Technology Services Department. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Adds $9,900 and one more year to Be a Mentor's vendor background-screening software contract
summary: This amendment extends the agreement with Be a Mentor, Inc. of Hayward, CA, from June 30, 2022 to June 30, 2023, and adds $9,900, raising the spending cap from $19,800 to $29,700. The company hosts the District's Vendor Management System, which handles vendor processing, background screening and clearances, and tracking of ongoing arrest records for up to 120 District vendors. The Board is ratifying (confirming) the change after the new term began on July 1, 2022.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 – Hanna Interpreting Services LLC – Special Education Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2022-2023 by and between the District and Hanna Interpreting Services LLC, Spring Valley, CA, for the latter to provide interpreting and document translation services: On-Demand Telephone Services equipped with a customer access code, On-Demand Video Remote Interpreting (VRI), Document Translation Services (XTRF) and Pre-Scheduling appointments, via the Special Education Department, for the period of August 25, 2022 through August 31, 2023, in an amount not to exceed $200,000.00.
headline: Approves up to $200,000 for Hanna Interpreting phone, video and document translation services
summary: The District is hiring Hanna Interpreting Services LLC of Spring Valley, CA, through the Special Education Department to provide on-demand phone interpreting, on-demand video interpreting, document translation, and pre-scheduled interpreting appointments. Spending is capped at $200,000 for August 25, 2022 through August 31, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - CyraCom International, Inc. – Special Education Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2022-2023 by and between the District and CyraCom International, Inc., Tucson, AZ, for the latter to provide Over-The-Phone Interpretation (“OPI”) Services, available twenty-four (24) hours per day each calendar day for the term of this Agreement, for the languages listed in Exhibit A of Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via the Special Education Department, for the period of August 25, 2022 through June 30, 2023, in an amount not to exceed $49,900.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $49,900 for CyraCom's 24-hour over-the-phone interpretation for Special Education
summary: The Board is ratifying (confirming) an agreement with CyraCom International, Inc. of Tucson, AZ, to provide over-the-phone interpretation, available 24 hours a day, in the languages listed in the agreement's Exhibit A. The Special Education Department is using the service, with spending capped at $49,900 for August 25, 2022 through June 30, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 – HeyTutor, Inc. – La Escuelita Elementary School - Special Education Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2022-2023 by and between the District and HeyTutor, Inc., Woodland Hills, CA, for the latter to provide Special Education students at La Escuelita Elementary School with high-dosage, in person tutoring, as described in Exhibit A of Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, in an attempt to close the unfinished learning gaps as brought on by the pandemic, via the Special Education Department, for the period of August 3, 2022 through August 3, 2023, in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for HeyTutor in-person tutoring for special education students at La Escuelita
summary: The Board is ratifying (confirming) an agreement with HeyTutor, Inc. of Woodland Hills, CA, to provide high-dosage, in-person tutoring to special education students at La Escuelita Elementary School. The goal is to close unfinished-learning gaps caused by the pandemic. Spending is capped at $50,000 for August 3, 2022 through August 3, 2023, and the term began before the Board's August 24, 2022 vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

summary: The Board is asked to confirm the Board President's pick for the Measure G Parcel Tax Independent Citizens Oversight Committee. This is the appointee's first term, filling a term that has not yet ended. The appointment runs from August 25, 2022, through January 31, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Minutes - Board of Education - Special Meeting - August 5, 2022
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of its Special Meeting Minutes of August 5, 2022, prepared by Staff shortly after said Meeting.
headline: Approves the minutes of the Board's August 5, 2022 special meeting
summary: The Board is asked to approve the written record (minutes) of its Special Meeting held on August 5, 2022. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after the meeting. There is no cost.
